report.title: Target Dummies crash the game when saved in editor
report.body:
### Platforms

Windows

### Build

bleeding-edge build 27733

### Issue

If a Target Dummy is placed in the editor and the map is saved, the game crashes. The map also causes an error if it is attempted to be loaded afterwards.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Place a target dummy in the editor
2. Save the map

### Mods used

None

### Save file

(As described above, this map is unloadable in-game.)
[dummy.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31756506/dummy.zip)

### (Crash) logs

[crash-report-09_02_2026_16_06_14.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31756477/crash-report-09_02_2026_16_06_14.txt)

summary: Post-readiness-fix qualification: 5/5 clean runs matched the save-crash signature. Original 4/5 attempt retained; human-fixed control pending.

spec.summary: Unverified report of Mindustry crashing when saving an editor map containing a Target Dummy, followed by an error when loading that map.
spec.bug_class: Reported editor save crash and subsequent map-load error; cause undetermined
spec.observed_behavior: The player reports that placing a Target Dummy in the editor and saving the map crashes the game. They also report an error when attempting to load the map afterward. Neither behavior has been independently verified, and the linked artifacts have not been inspected.
spec.expected_behavior: Saving an editor map containing a Target Dummy should complete without crashing, and the saved map should load without errors.
known_preconditions: Reported build: bleeding-edge build 27733; the separate build_version field is null.
The reported sequence involves placing a Target Dummy in the editor before saving.
uncertain_conditions: Whether the reported crash and load error are reproducible, and with what frequency.
Whether the supplied target commit corresponds to reported build 27733.
Whether Linux, the planned evaluation platform, exhibits either reported behavior.
Whether the map was new or existing, and its dimensions, settings, contents, and prior save history.
The Target Dummy's configuration and placement details.
The exact save workflow and point at which the reported crash occurs.
The exact subsequent load-error message and whether that attempt also crashes.
Whether saving completes before the crash and whether the map remains recoverable.
Whether maps without a Target Dummy exhibit either behavior under otherwise comparable conditions.
Windows version, runtime details, and installation configuration.
reproduction_hints: Player-provided steps, not independently executed: place a Target Dummy in the editor, then save the map.
The player also reports an error when subsequently attempting to load the saved map.
Preserve the supplied map archive and use a copy for any evaluation.
Record the actual build, commit, platform, save outcome, and load outcome separately during evaluation.
required_artifacts: Contents of the linked map archive, not inspected: https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31756506/dummy.zip
Contents of the linked crash report, not inspected: https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31756477/crash-report-09_02_2026_16_06_14.txt
Exact error text or logs from the subsequent map-load attempt.
Build identification confirming the relationship between build 27733 and the supplied target commit.
Complete reproduction details, including map setup, Target Dummy configuration, save workflow, and attempt counts.
Environment details for the reported Windows installation and any Linux evaluation.

hypotheses.statement: Saving a new editor map containing one Target Dummy crashes this running build.
hypotheses.prediction: After placing a Target Dummy and saving, the process exits or displays a save error.
hypotheses.observation: One attempt: created DummyRepro with default settings, searched target, selected Target Dummy, placed one with pencil near center without configuration, then Menu > Save Map. Process exited with code 1. Runtime log reports Error writing region "map", caused by NullPointerException: Cannot read field "id" because "this.unitTeam" is null at TargetDummy$TargetDummyBuild.write(TargetDummy.java:271).
